text:
NEEDS_FIX: YES
<assessment>Across the collage, the source shows a tall timber-framed glazed gable hall, a lower front-left sloped glazed annex, the ground-floor café and curtain wall, a projecting upper terrace with its lower fascia and supports, a separate upper timber canopy, an exterior stair, and a timber-clad side wall. The interior panel confirms the open glazed gable hall and exposed rafters. The current views contain the hall, annex, stair, terrace fascia, and an open ground-floor column bay. The upper close-up shows umbrellas and the main roof framing but no distinct projecting timber canopy; the side-wall close-up shows a mostly smooth peach surface with sparse seams where the source has articulated timber cladding.</assessment>
<issue priority="1" view="oblique">problem: The source has a separate projecting timber canopy with its own supports at the upper hall/terrace. The current close-ups show the main gable roof and terrace umbrellas; the broad lower terrace fascia does not provide that canopy. action: Add the missing upper canopy and its supports as a local patch, separate from the existing lower fascia.</issue>
<issue priority="2" view="right">problem: The source side wall reads as timber paneling, while the current close-up is largely smooth with only a few wide seams. action: Add a repeated timber panel joint rhythm and shallow relief to the existing wall while retaining its warm material zone.</issue>
<keep>Front-left sloped glazed lower annex at the ground-to-fascia span.
Glazed gable hall with its exposed timber roof framing.
Lower projecting terrace fascia and the open front/right ground-floor column bay.</keep>
